scope: Official sources and denominator compatibility; no claim of complete collection, connector installation, or verified findings.

notes: New Albany crosses Franklin and Licking counties.
Columbus place boundaries are not Franklin County boundaries.
Portsmouth city in Scioto County is distinct from the DOE Portsmouth site in Pike County.

sources.title: Census ACS five-year detailed tables

access.key_requirement: Census API key required for data queries; metadata queries are exempt, per June 2026 Census notice.

sources.geography: Match summary level, complete GEOID and boundary vintage; use published county/place/tract/block-group/school-district geography rather than matching display names.
sources.time: Default research baseline: ACS 2020-2024 five-year period, API vintage 2024. It is a period estimate, not a 2026 headcount.

denominator_contracts.universe: Occupied housing units; do not divide by B25001 total housing units.
Population for whom poverty status is determined; not B01003 total population.
Population 25 years and over; not pupils or graduating cohorts.

denominator_contracts.measure: Rent burden at least 30 percent, among computed cases
denominator_contracts.universe: Use an explicitly labeled computed-case rate; disclose excluded not-computed cases.

sources.join_rule: Use estimates, MOEs and annotations from the same dataset, period and geography. Retain raw sentinel values; no automatic conversion to zero.
blocked_inferences: Area averages do not describe named people.
Do not treat ACS adult attainment as current school performance.
Do not call an apparent change significant without uncertainty treatment; overlapping ACS periods are not independent.

sources.title: Ohio school report card downloads and accountability business rules

access.mode: public aggregate Excel downloads; OEDS organization extract
access.key_requirement: No key advertised for these public downloads. No supported public API contract verified.

sources.geography: School/building and district IRNs identify institutions. Crosswalk IRN to NCES/Census district identifiers explicitly; names and school street addresses are insufficient.
sources.time: Resources currently link 2025-2026 report cards. Preserve school year, fiscal year and graduation cohort separately; report-card year does not make all components contemporaneous.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Published qualifying students missing at least 10 percent of possible attendance
denominator_contracts.denominator: Published qualifying students under that year's attendance rules
denominator_contracts.universe: 2025-2026 accountability rules require at least 100 hours of possible attendance and contain placement exceptions; use the official aggregate denominator, not ACS school-age population.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Same district and fiscal-year spending category
denominator_contracts.denominator: Enrollment/FTE/ADM required by that finance measure
denominator_contracts.universe: These pupil counts are not interchangeable; preserve source definition.
Not current enrollment or adults with diplomas.

sources.join_rule: Join finance, attendance and enrollment by institution ID and explicitly matched periods. Geographic resident context remains a separate layer because students can cross district boundaries.
blocked_inferences: Do not infer causation from a neighborhood poverty association.
Retain suppression/missing flags; do not reconstruct small protected groups.
Do not sum building/district accountability counts without de-duplication rules.
sources.collection_status: official download entry point and methods reviewed; workbook not imported

sources.title: SAIPE school-district estimates and Census boundary vintages

access.mode: public dataset/boundary downloads; Census API where supported
access.key_requirement: Public downloads need no Census key. Census data API queries require a Census key; metadata is exempt.

sources.geography: School-district geography and its vintage, district type and Census district code. Match to an audited institution crosswalk; do not treat a county or attendance zone as the district.
sources.time: Use the SAIPE estimate year and corresponding district boundary edition. TIGERweb current boundaries are not automatically the correct boundaries for historical ACS/SAIPE data.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Related children ages 5-17 in families in poverty
denominator_contracts.universe: Census explicitly says this is not a true child poverty rate because the universes differ; retain the published labels and purpose.

sources.join_rule: Use SAIPE as resident-area context and Title I-related research. Verify school-district ID, grade-range responsibility and boundary year before relating to Ohio district finance or enrollment.
blocked_inferences: Resident school-age population is not enrolled students.
SAIPE school-district figures do not provide tract or block-group measurements.
sources.collection_status: methods reviewed; no estimates or boundaries downloaded

sources.title: FBI Crime Data Explorer

access.mode: public CDE downloads first; current API contract requires separate verification
access.key_requirement: Official legacy FBI repository documents api.data.gov keys, but its routes are old. Current JavaScript API documentation was not readable in this audit; do not assume a legacy endpoint or existing key works.

sources.geography: Reporting agency ORI and covered population/jurisdiction; agency territory may differ from city/county boundaries and overlap other agencies.
sources.time: Preserve calendar month/year, publication/revision date, NIBRS/SRS series and reported versus estimated status. FBI's monthly release announcement describes a rolling 12-month preliminary window with a three-month lag.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Offenses from a fixed agency set and explicitly complete matching reporting months
denominator_contracts.denominator: Corresponding source-defined population served for that period and coverage
denominator_contracts.universe: Do not divide Columbus agency counts by Franklin County ACS population; do not annualize missing months as zeros.

sources.join_rule: Import agency participation/reporting months alongside every crime table. Preserve offense/incident/victim/arrest units separately. Resolve agency coverage before any population join.
blocked_inferences: Police-recorded crime is not all victimization.
Missing or partial reporting is not zero crime.
Surveillance equipment counts and crime trends alone do not prove an intervention caused a change.
sources.collection_status: official entry point and release-method notice reviewed; current API and Ohio agency completeness not verified

sources.title: EPA ECHO public web services

access.mode: public query-only GET services; bulk download for large collections
access.key_requirement: EPA documents public services accessed by URL; no API key requirement stated on reviewed documentation. No live query executed.

sources.geography: FRS facility ID plus program-specific permit/system IDs (such as NPDES and drinking-water system ID); facility point, outfall, watershed and service area answer different questions.
sources.time: Retain source-system reporting period, ECHO refresh date and retrieval date separately. Refresh schedules vary by program.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Same permit, pollutant, unit, reporting period and monitoring location
denominator_contracts.denominator: Use the permit limit/flow/basis required for that measurement; population is not a compliance denominator
denominator_contracts.universe: A local demographic overlay is descriptive context, not a compliance calculation.

sources.join_rule: Trace search results to detailed facility/program records, permit text, DMRs and dated enforcement documents. Resolve company identity with documented facility/permit ownership.
blocked_inferences: A permit, inspection or database flag is not by itself a finding of unlawful conduct.
A facility location or nearby population does not establish actual exposure.
An ECHO refresh date is not necessarily the underlying measurement date.
sources.collection_status: service and source documentation reviewed; no facility collection

sources.title: EPA TRI reported releases and RSEI screening model

access.key_requirement: No API key required for public explanatory pages/download access; no programmatic endpoint tested.

sources.geography: TRI facility ID, release location and medium; RSEI modeled geography is distinct from county/tract administrative boundaries.
sources.time: Keep TRI reporting year, revision date and RSEI model version together. Compare consistent chemical coverage and modeling versions.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Chemical-specific release amount by medium and year
denominator_contracts.denominator: None required for original quantity; any population normalization must be labeled a descriptive reporting metric
denominator_contracts.universe: Pounds released are not a measure of individual dose.

denominator_contracts.denominator: Do not invent a health-rate denominator
denominator_contracts.universe: Unitless comparative screening score; neither predicted cancer cases nor a formal risk assessment.

sources.join_rule: Use releases, toxicity/model context and nearby-area ACS characteristics to prioritize records requests; then seek permit conditions, monitoring results and appropriate site-specific assessment.
blocked_inferences: TRI does not cover all sources or all chemicals.
Proximity alone is not exposure; a high score is not proof of illness or noncompliance.
Do not sum mass across chemicals and present the result as comparative health risk.
sources.collection_status: methods reviewed; no release or model outputs collected

sources.title: County auditor/GIS and recorder records

access.mode: public GIS extracts or official search portals; recorder access varies
access.key_requirement: No Regrid key needed for Franklin public extracts. Other portals have no single shared API contract; obey account/access requirements and check each service before automation.

sources.geography: County FIPS plus parcel ID and parcel version; preserve split/merge history. Tax district, municipal boundary, school district and Census tract are separate spatial layers.
sources.time: Record deed execution/recording dates, tax year, valuation status and GIS extract date separately. Pike currently labels TY2026 values tentative.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Documented actual foregone tax or separately labeled forecast, allocated to the correct taxing jurisdiction and period
denominator_contracts.denominator: Matched district fiscal-year pupil measure or clearly labeled ACS household context
denominator_contracts.universe: A modeled amount per household is not a household bill; tax assessment is not tax payment.

sources.join_rule: Parcel ID to recorded instrument and legal grantee; then agreement/ordinance identifier to abatement/TIF and fiscal records. Spatial overlay to matching-year school/tax boundaries, with documented CRS and boundary treatment.
blocked_inferences: Owner display or registered agent alone does not establish beneficial ownership.
A common address or legal entity association does not prove misconduct.
GIS parcel count is not a count of housing units or renters.
sources.collection_status: official entry points reviewed; no complete county parcel collections; no recorder chain-of-title investigation

sources.title: EIA electricity data plus local utility governing records

access.mode: EIA public annual files; API for available series; public ordinance/docket documents
access.key_requirement: EIA API needs its own free EIA key; public EIA-861 files do not. No additional key is needed just to read listed local records.

sources.geography: Utility ID, state, customer sector and service territory. EIA retail-sales API route is state/sector context; do not label it a Columbus household bill or utility-specific measurement.
sources.time: Match annual/monthly data frequency, sector, dollar basis, billing period and tariff effective date. Keep measured consumption, contracted capacity and projected demand distinct.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Same utility/state/sector/period revenue with explicit unit conversion
denominator_contracts.universe: Customers/accounts are not Census households; MW capacity is not MWh energy.

denominator_contracts.numerator: Actual metered consumption or separately labeled allocation/design forecast
denominator_contracts.denominator: Correct service-area usage/capacity/customer class, period and unit
denominator_contracts.universe: Columbus water service area includes contract communities; city or county households are not automatically the customer denominator.

sources.join_rule: Project/parcel to service agreement and utility/customer class; then approved tariff, infrastructure cost allocation and actual aggregate usage. Columbus 2560-2026 is a rate-proposal reporting record, not itself a rate schedule; track its October 26, 2026 reporting deadline.
blocked_inferences: A tariff minimum is not proof of an actual payment.
State averages do not establish local bill changes.
A permit/allocation does not prove operating consumption.
sources.collection_status: methods and governing-record entry points reviewed; no customer usage or full docket collection

common_capture_contract.publication_state: unreviewed until records and calculations are checked
common_capture_contract.privacy: Aggregate school and demographic outputs; no student/personnel records, private addresses or credentials.
common_capture_contract.comparison_rule: Preserve raw responses, publication/revision timestamps and actual reviewed scope; a fetched landing page does not complete a lane. Missing/suppressed/not-reported values are never zero.
